body:
selfhost/emit.prn now supports a nested alloc call as a call argument (f (alloc dest String "lit")), closing the one exclusion the nested-call-argument work named as still open. alloc-call-shaped?/emit-alloc-call already carry their own explicit Arena target, so no new obstacle -- every-call-arg-symbol-or-number? gained a 4th accepted shape, emit-call-arg gained matching dispatch. Crash-regression fixture's negative case moved to a raw string-literal argument (still genuinely unsupported). New positive coverage including a real compile+run+assert check proving the nested alloc genuinely allocates into the correct Arena at runtime. Also confirmed a real, separate, pre-existing gap in passing: emit-program emits no forward prototypes (callee must precede caller) -- not attempted here. Zero regressions: 336-test suite + all 6 selfhost domains + bazel build/test clean. PARENA commit 5d3fa47.

⚓ ☃
title: Self-hosted compiler: nested-alloc-call-as-a-call-argument support
